name: Humblebrag Climb
hook: Stack insufferable thought leadership buzzwords until LinkedIn breaks
tagline: Watch a crisp blazer-clad executive hammer out an escalating humblebrag post about waking up at 3:30 AM to network with stray alley cats. Cashing out locks in thousands of clapping reactions and an unearned keynote invitation. Crashing triggers a merciless screenshot critique that circulates company Slack channels.
